title: Death of a Salesman

vibeProfile.oneLine: An aging salesman's illusions and the American Dream collapse together.

summary: Willy Loman, an aging travelling salesman who has staked his life on being well-liked and successful, unravels as his illusions and his strained relationship with his sons finally collapse. Arthur Miller's devastating play is the great American tragedy of the ordinary man, a searing critique of the American Dream and the cost of a life built on self-deception. Moving fluidly between present and memory, it remains one of the most powerful and widely performed plays of the twentieth century.
whyReadIt: The great American tragedy of the ordinary man, and a searing critique of the American Dream. Devastating.

funFacts.text: It won the Pulitzer Prize and is one of the most performed American plays ever written.
